# Vendored fonts

Both fonts are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (full text with copyright lines in `OFL.txt`). The files are the
unmodified Google Fonts woff2 subsets (variable weight axis), fetched 2026-11-11 from fonts.gstatic.com so the page and
the video render need no network:

| file | family | subset | weights |
|---|---|---|---|
| `space-grotesk-latin.woff2` | Space Grotesk | latin | 300 to 700 |
| `space-grotesk-latin-ext.woff2` | Space Grotesk | latin-ext | 300 to 700 |
| `jetbrains-mono-latin.woff2` | JetBrains Mono | latin | 100 to 800 |
| `jetbrains-mono-latin-ext.woff2` | JetBrains Mono | latin-ext | 100 to 800 |
| `jetbrains-mono-greek.woff2` | JetBrains Mono | greek | 100 to 800 |

Upstream: https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk and https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono.
